description: Railway — Station locations is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. This dataset is available on Brisbane City Council’s open data website – data.brisbane.qld.gov.au. The site provides additional features for viewing and interacting with the data and for downloading the data in various formats. This dataset published by Brisbane City Council contains the locations of South East Queensland railway stations. Coverage: Brisbane City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are arcgis, queensland rail, railway, roads traffic and parking, stations. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
